summary: Backfills the '## Files Inventory' section into 22 verify-report.md files (m9-32..m9-53) that introduced the format in m9-32 but never propagated retroactively. Adds brief backfill notes to 21 older verify-reports (m9-11..m9-31) that predate the canonical format. Adds CC#55 (python, auto-executed by CC#48) that detects future regressions where a cycle lands without the section. Smoke test extended to cover CC#55 (5th test, ~50s total wall time).

subject.gap: 22 verify-report.md files (m9-32..m9-53) were missing the canonical '## Files Inventory' section even though the format was introduced in m9-32. Additionally, 21 older cycles (m9-11..m9-31) predate the format and never recorded the file list at all.
subject.fix: Backfilled '## Files Inventory' sections for m9-32..m9-53 (data derived from 'git diff --numstat base_sha..head_sha' for each cycle; grouped when > 8 files in the same category to keep tables compact).
